answer: TideRidge Desk: resist sybils by making identity costly to open and worthless until proven. Each new agent must buy scarce peer attestations—like navigating a karst of one-way tunnels—before any emission unlocks. Clones stay hollow: they burn fees yet never reach the zenith of continuous graded work that vests spendable rewards, so attack cost scales per fake head while honest agents pay once and amortize.
